_purpose: Hand-written documentation of every mart_* table: group, grain and purpose per table, unit / additivity / meaning per column. build_warehouse.py loads it into semantic_table_doc / semantic_column_doc and FAILS if a mart column is undocumented.

data_period.data_nature: synthetic POC data that mirrors the Panchatantra 2.0 (RDPR Karnataka) portal

rules: Query only mart_* tables. Dates are text 'YYYY-MM-DD', fy is text like '2024-25', month_label is upper-case text like 'APR-2025'. Order months by month_id.

Geography is Zilla (district) > Taluk > GP (Gram Panchayat). GP-level facts carry gp_name, taluk_name and zilla_name already, so filter on them directly (zilla_name = 'Mysuru'). GP names repeat across taluks: for one GP always also filter taluk_name (or use gp_id).
State totals: SUM over all rows. Zilla or taluk totals: GROUP BY zilla_name / taluk_name over the GP-level fact. Never read a taluk-level fact when a GP-level one answers the question.

For a zilla or statewide total prefer the pre-summed mart_agg_taluk_* tables (SUM over their taluk rows, GROUP BY zilla_name for a zilla breakdown): they hold the same figures as the GP-level facts and answer in milliseconds. Use the GP-level mart_fact_gp_* tables for questions about individual GPs.
Money is in Indian rupees (INR). 1 lakh = 100,000 and 1 crore = 10,000,000. Return INR from SQL (ROUND(...,2)); do not divide by 1e7 unless asked for crore.

Revenue DCB (mart_fact_gp_dcb and the fee-type / property-type splits): arrears = previous FY's balance; total_demand = arrears + year_demand; balance = total_demand - total_collection - adjustments. year_demand, total_collection and adjustments are flows (can be added across FYs); arrears, total_demand and balance are positions (add across places within ONE FY, never across FYs).

Collection % = SUM(total_collection)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(total_demand),0) over the rows in scope. Never AVG or SUM a *_pct column across rows (collection_pct, closure_pct, all_books_closed_pct, scheme_books_closed_pct); a stored pct may be read as-is only for one row of its own grain.

Book-closure %: Finance holds one row per scheme book. Year closure % = SUM(is_closed)*100.0/COUNT(*) over mart_fact_gp_year_closure rows in scope (filter scheme_name for one scheme); month closure % the same over mart_fact_gp_month_closure. 'GPs that closed ALL books for the year' is all_books_closed in mart_summary_gp_year (SUM over GPs). Not every GP keeps every scheme, so counts differ by scheme.

Scheme money (mart_fact_gp_scheme_financials): receipts and expenditure are flows (add over months); opening_balance and closing_balance are positions (add across GPs for ONE month, never across months; for a year take the March closing balance).

Two Finance Commission schemes have ended: Fourteen Finance Commission Grants has no rows after FY 2022-23 and Fifteen Finance Commission Grants none after FY 2025-26 (see active_to_fy in mart_dim_scheme). Do not expect them in FY 2026-27.
Day-book closure (mart_fact_taluk_daybook_closure) is taluk level: for one day use SUM(gps_closed)*100.0/SUM(total_gps); never AVG(closure_pct) and never add counts across days.

HRMS snapshots (mart_fact_gp_eo_approval, mart_fact_gp_er_registration) are one row per FY and GP taken on the snapshot_date: add across places within one FY, never across FYs. Presidents / vice-presidents are 1 or 0 per GP.

Staff headcount is in mart_fact_taluk_staff (taluk level, no names). Current (active) staff = SUM(staff_count) WHERE employment_status = 'Active'. There are no individual records: never answer about a named person, salary of a person, date of birth or the like.

Salary bills (mart_fact_taluk_salary_bills) exist at TALUK level only, never by GP, per month and staff type; months run Jan-2022 to Sep-2026 (Jan-Mar 2022 belong to FY 2021-22). If asked for salary bills by GP set answerable=false.

'Now', 'currently', 'latest', 'this year' mean the end of the data, 30-Sep-2026, so the current FY is 2026-27 (April-September 2026 only; its year-end book closure and year-end figures are not complete). 'Last year' / 'last FY' means FY 2025-26, the latest complete year.

Cross-module questions: use the mart_summary_*_year views (one row per place and FY, Finance + Revenue + HRMS already combined) or aggregate each fact to the same grain first. Never join two raw facts of different grain directly: rows multiply and totals are wrong.

Rankings: exclude NULLs, ORDER BY the measure and LIMIT. Name the entity and the measure in the SELECT. 'Top' means highest, 'worst' / 'lowest' means smallest value (for dues or pending counts the largest value is the worst).
Give EVERY selected column an alias. Use only columns listed in the schema; if the question needs data that is not listed, set answerable=false instead of guessing.

DCB.plain: Demand, Collection and Balance register: for each GP and year, the tax and fee demand (arrears plus the year's demand), what was collected, adjustments, and the balance still to be collected.

Arrears.plain: Dues carried in from earlier years: equal to the previous year's closing balance.

Balance.plain: What is still to be collected at the end of the year: total demand minus collection minus adjustments.

Collection percentage.plain: Amount collected as a percentage of the total demand.

Gram Panchayat.plain: The village-level local body. Karnataka has 6,099 GPs in this data, grouped into 238 taluks and 31 zillas.

Zilla.plain: The district level of Panchayat Raj. Karnataka has 31 zillas in this data.

Taluk.plain: The block level between a GP and a zilla. There are 238 taluks in this data.

Book closure.plain: A GP closes the books of each scheme account at the end of a month or year after reconciling receipts and expenditure. The portal tracks which GPs have closed which books.

Day book.plain: The daily cash book of a scheme account. Day-book closure counts the GPs of a taluk that have closed the day's book.

Scheme.plain: A separate account a GP keeps for each funding source, such as Finance Commission grants, Swachh Bharat Mission or its own resources. There are 13 scheme accounts.

RGSA.plain: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan, the central scheme for strengthening Panchayat Raj institutions.

SBM-G.plain: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin), the sanitation scheme.

ESCROW.plain: The statutory grants account (ESCROW) into which state statutory grants are paid.

VWSC.plain: Village Water Supply and Sanitation Committee account.

ORF.plain: Own Resource Funds: the GP's own tax and fee revenue account.

EO.plain: Executive Officer of the Taluk Panchayat, who approves staff registered by GPs.

PDO.plain: Panchayat Development Officer, the GP's chief executive; signs the GP's bills.

Adhyaksha.plain: The elected President of a GP. The vice-president is the Upadhyaksha.

HRMS.plain: The Human Resource Management System for GP staff: registration, EO approval and monthly salary bills.

Main bill.plain: The regular monthly salary bill of a GP. Auxiliary bills are supplementary ones. A bill goes from generated, to PDO signed, to President signed, to processed by the bank.

ER.plain: Elected Representative registration: the seats in a GP body and the members, president and vice-president registered.

LGD.plain: Local Government Directory code, the official numeric code of a zilla, taluk or GP.

Lakh and crore.plain: Indian number units: 1 lakh = 100,000 and 1 crore = 10,000,000 rupees.

S09: village water supply and sanitation committee

fy.doc: Financial year label, text like '2024-25' (April to March). FY 2026-27 holds April-September 2026 only.

fy_id.doc: Short financial-year key such as FY2425 (use fy instead).

month_id.doc: Calendar-month key YYYYMM, e.g. 202504 for April 2025; sorts chronologically.

month_label.doc: Month as upper-case text 'APR-2025' (calendar month and year; April is the first month of the FY).

gp_id.doc: Gram Panchayat key G0001..G6099. GP names repeat across taluks; use gp_id or gp_name with taluk_name.

gp_name.doc: Gram Panchayat name (not unique: 'Siddapura' exists in 9 taluks).

gp_lgd_code.doc: Official LGD code of the GP.

taluk_lgd_code.doc: Official LGD code of the taluk.

zilla_lgd_code.doc: Official LGD code of the zilla.

scheme_name.doc: Scheme / fund account the books are kept for, e.g. 'Fifteen Finance Commission Grants'.

scheme_category.doc: Central, State, Earmarked, Finance Commission or Own.

fee_type_name.doc: Revenue head: Application Fees, Property Taxes, Other Taxes, Fees, Mobile Tower Tax.

property_type_name.doc: Property type as in the demand statistics, e.g. 'Residential', 'Commercial'.

report_category.doc: Grouped property category (residential, commercial, industrial, community, government ...).

staff_type_code.doc: Staff type code (1 Government, 2 Contractual, 4 GP Staff, 6 Outsourced, 7 Librarian, 8 Rehabilitation, 9 RGPR Fellows).

arrears.doc: Dues carried in from earlier years = the previous FY's closing balance. Cumulative: never add across FYs.

year_demand.doc: Demand raised for this FY alone (current demand). A flow: can be added across FYs.

total_demand.doc: arrears + year_demand. Contains the carried-in arrears, so never add across FYs.

total_collection.doc: Amount collected in the FY. A flow: can be added across FYs.

adjustments.doc: Write-offs / adjustments in the FY. A flow.

balance.doc: Outstanding at FY end = total_demand - total_collection - adjustments. A position: add across places within one FY, never across FYs.

collection_amount.doc: Amount collected in the calendar month for the revenue head. A flow.

opening_balance.doc: Scheme bank/cash balance at the start of the month. A position: never add across months.

receipts.doc: Money received into the scheme account in the month. A flow.

expenditure.doc: Money spent from the scheme account in the month. A flow.

closing_balance.doc: Scheme balance at month end (= opening + receipts - expenditure). A position: never add across months.

monthly_gross_salary_inr.doc: Total monthly gross salary of the staff in the group (sum over people in the row).

total_gps.doc: Number of GPs in scope (a stock, not a flow: do not add across days or months).

gps_closed.doc: GPs whose book was closed on that day (cumulative to the day within the month).

gps_pending.doc: GPs whose book was still open on that day.

closure_pct.doc: gps_closed as a percentage of total_gps for that taluk, scheme and day. A ratio: never average across rows; use SUM(gps_closed)*100/SUM(total_gps) for one day.

is_closed.doc: 1 if the scheme's book was closed for the period, else 0. Closure % = SUM(is_closed)*100.0/COUNT(*).

closed_on.doc: Date the book was closed (text YYYY-MM-DD) or NULL if not closed.

days_after_month_end.doc: Days between month end and closure; NULL if not closed.

number_of_properties.doc: Properties on the GP tax register (a stock, not summed across FYs).

staff_count.doc: Number of staff in the row's group (all rows of a taluk sum to its total).

snapshot_date.doc: Date the HRMS figures were taken (31-Dec for past FYs, the data end for the current FY).

staff_registrations_sent_to_eo.doc: Staff registrations sent to the Executive Officer (snapshot for the FY).

staff_approved_by_eo.doc: Staff approved by the Executive Officer (snapshot for the FY).

staff_approval_pending_at_eo.doc: Staff registrations still waiting for EO approval (snapshot for the FY).

staff_registrations_rejected_by_eo.doc: Staff registrations rejected by the EO (snapshot for the FY).

staff_resent_for_approval_to_eo.doc: Rejected registrations sent again to the EO (snapshot for the FY).

total_seats.doc: Seats in the GP body (snapshot for the FY).

total_elected_members.doc: Elected members registered (snapshot for the FY).

total_adhyaksha_president.doc: Presidents (Adhyaksha) registered: 1 when the GP has one, 0 when none (snapshot).

total_number_of_staff.doc: Staff on the payroll in the taluk for the staff type in the month.

number_of_gps_generated_main_bill.doc: GPs that generated the main salary bill in the month.

number_of_main_bill_pdo_signed.doc: Main bills signed by the PDO.

number_of_main_bill_president_signed.doc: Main bills signed by the President.

number_of_main_bill_processed_by_bank.doc: Main bills processed by the bank.

number_of_auxiliary_bill_pdo_signed.doc: Auxiliary bills signed by the PDO.

number_of_auxiliary_bill_president_signe.doc: Auxiliary bills signed by the President.

number_of_auxiliary_bill_processed_by_ba.doc: Auxiliary bills processed by the bank.

number_of_staff_salary_paid.doc: Staff whose salary was paid in the month.

number_of_staff_salary_rejected_by_bank.doc: Staff whose salary the bank rejected in the month.

designation_name.doc: Designation, e.g. 'Panchayat Development Officer', 'Bill Collector', 'Water Operator'.

taluk_assignment.doc: 'portal' or 'reassigned' (GP moved to a different taluk from its LGD code).

size_class.doc: GP size class: Small, Medium or Large.

performance_tier.doc: GP performance tier: Strong, Average or Lagging.

total_taluks.doc: Number of taluks in the zilla.

start_date.doc: First day of the financial year.

end_date.doc: Last day of the financial year.

data_through.doc: Last date for which data exists in that FY.

is_current.doc: 1 for the FY the data ends in.

is_complete.doc: 1 if the FY has all twelve months of data, 0 for the partial current FY.

active_from_fy.doc: First FY the scheme exists in.

active_to_fy.doc: Last FY the scheme exists in (NULL = still active).

schemes_total.doc: Scheme books the GP keeps for the FY.

schemes_closed.doc: Of those, books closed for the year.

all_books_closed.doc: 1 if every scheme book of the GP was closed for the year, else 0.

revenue_balance.doc: Revenue balance outstanding at FY end (same as balance).

collection_pct.doc: total_collection as % of total_demand. A ratio: recompute as SUM(total_collection)*100.0/SUM(total_demand).

gps_all_books_closed.doc: GPs that closed every scheme book for the FY.

all_books_closed_pct.doc: gps_all_books_closed as % of total_gps. A ratio.

scheme_books_closed_pct.doc: Closed scheme books as % of all scheme books in the place. A ratio.

month_books_closed.doc: Month-end scheme books closed (GP x scheme) in the month. Month closure % = SUM(month_books_closed)*100.0/SUM(month_books) over ONE month or a GROUP BY month.

month_books.doc: Month-end scheme books kept (GP x scheme) in the month: the denominator of month closure %.

scheme_books_closed.doc: Year-end scheme books closed (GP x scheme) for the FY. Year closure % = SUM(scheme_books_closed)*100.0/SUM(scheme_books).

scheme_books.doc: Year-end scheme books kept (GP x scheme) for the FY: the denominator of year closure %.

mart_dim_zilla.doc: The 31 zillas with their taluk and GP counts.

mart_dim_taluk.doc: The 238 taluks with their zilla and number of GPs.

mart_dim_gp.doc: The 6,099 GPs with taluk, zilla, size class and performance tier.

mart_dim_month.doc: Months Jan-2022 to Mar-2027 with fiscal month number.

mart_dim_scheme.doc: The 13 scheme account books of a GP.

mart_dim_fee_type.doc: Application Fees, Property Taxes, Other Taxes, Fees, Mobile Tower Tax.

mart_dim_property_type.doc: The 30 property types and their grouped category.

mart_fact_gp_year_closure.grain: one row per FY x GP x scheme
mart_fact_gp_year_closure.doc: Whether each scheme's books were closed for the year. Closure % = SUM(is_closed)*100.0/COUNT(*).

mart_fact_gp_month_closure.grain: one row per month x GP x scheme
mart_fact_gp_month_closure.doc: Whether each scheme's books were closed for the month, and how many days after month end.

mart_fact_gp_scheme_financials.grain: one row per month x GP x scheme
mart_fact_gp_scheme_financials.doc: Opening balance, receipts, expenditure and closing balance of each scheme account.

mart_fact_taluk_daybook_closure.grain: one row per day x taluk x scheme
mart_fact_taluk_daybook_closure.doc: Daily count of GPs in the taluk that have closed the day book. Taluk level.

mart_fact_gp_dcb.grain: one row per FY x GP
mart_fact_gp_dcb.doc: Demand, collection and balance (DCB register): arrears, year demand, total demand, collection, adjustments, balance.

mart_fact_gp_fee_type.grain: one row per FY x GP x revenue head
mart_fact_gp_fee_type.doc: The DCB figures split by revenue head (taxes and fees).

mart_fact_gp_monthly_collection.grain: one row per month x GP x revenue head
mart_fact_gp_monthly_collection.doc: Collection by calendar month and revenue head.

mart_fact_gp_demand_by_property_type.grain: one row per FY x GP x property type
mart_fact_gp_demand_by_property_type.doc: The DCB figures split by property type, with number of properties.

mart_fact_gp_property_counts.grain: one row per FY x GP
mart_fact_gp_property_counts.doc: Number of properties in the GP by property category.

mart_fact_gp_eo_approval.grain: one row per FY x GP (snapshot)
mart_fact_gp_eo_approval.doc: Staff registrations sent to, approved, pending, rejected and resent to the Executive Officer.

mart_fact_gp_er_registration.grain: one row per FY x GP (snapshot)
mart_fact_gp_er_registration.doc: Elected-representative registration: seats, elected members, presidents and vice-presidents.

mart_fact_taluk_salary_bills.grain: one row per month x taluk x staff type
mart_fact_taluk_salary_bills.doc: The monthly salary-bill funnel (generated, signed, bank processed, paid, rejected). Taluk level only, never GP.

mart_fact_taluk_staff.grain: one row per taluk x staff type x designation x gender x employment status x approval status
mart_fact_taluk_staff.doc: Counts of GP staff (no names): the headcount and salary bill by designation as at the data end.

mart_summary_gp_year.grain: one row per FY x GP
mart_summary_gp_year.doc: Finance + Revenue + HRMS in one row per GP and FY: books closed, demand, collection, EO approvals, seats.

mart_summary_taluk_year.grain: one row per FY x taluk
mart_summary_taluk_year.doc: The same cross-module summary per taluk and FY.

mart_summary_zilla_year.grain: one row per FY x zilla
mart_summary_zilla_year.doc: The same cross-module summary per zilla and FY.

mart_summary_state_year.doc: The same cross-module summary for the whole state per FY.

mart_agg_taluk_month.grain: one row per calendar month x taluk
mart_agg_taluk_month.doc: Pre-summed monthly figures per taluk across the three modules: revenue collected, scheme receipts / expenditure / closing balance, month-end books closed, and salary bills. A zilla or the state is a SUM over its taluks. Fastest table for monthly zilla or statewide questions.

mart_agg_taluk_fy.grain: one row per FY x taluk
mart_agg_taluk_fy.doc: Pre-summed yearly figures per taluk across the three modules: DCB (arrears, demand, collection, adjustments, balance), properties, year-end books closed, GPs that closed every book, scheme receipts / expenditure, EO approvals and elected-member registration. A zilla or the state is a SUM over its taluks. Fastest table for zilla or statewide FY questions.

mart_agg_taluk_fee_type_fy.grain: one row per FY x taluk x revenue head
mart_agg_taluk_fee_type_fy.doc: DCB per taluk and revenue head for each FY (sum of mart_fact_gp_fee_type). Use for zilla or statewide revenue-head questions.

mart_agg_taluk_property_fy.grain: one row per FY x taluk x property category
mart_agg_taluk_property_fy.doc: Properties, demand, collection and balance per taluk and property category for each FY (sum of mart_fact_gp_demand_by_property_type).

mart_agg_taluk_scheme_fy.grain: one row per FY x taluk x scheme
mart_agg_taluk_scheme_fy.doc: Per taluk and scheme account for each FY: year-end books closed, receipts and expenditure over the FY, and the closing balance at the last month of the FY.

mart_fact_taluk_staff.staff_count.doc: People in the group. Add across rows for headcount; Active staff = employment_status = 'Active'.

mart_summary_gp_year.total_demand.doc: arrears + year_demand for the FY (contains carried-in arrears: never add across FYs).

mart_fact_taluk_daybook_closure.total_gp.doc: GPs in the taluk that keep this scheme's book on that day (stock, never added across days).

mart_fact_gp_demand_by_property_type.num.doc: Properties of this type in the GP (stock, not added across FYs).

mart_agg_taluk_scheme_fy.closing_balance.doc: Scheme balance at the last month of the FY (March, or September 2026 for the current FY). A position: add across places, never across FYs.

mart_agg_taluk_fy.total_gps.doc: GPs in the taluk (add across taluks within one FY).

mart_agg_taluk_fy.receipts.doc: Scheme receipts over the whole FY (all schemes). A flow.

mart_agg_taluk_fy.expenditure.doc: Scheme expenditure over the whole FY (all schemes). A flow.

mart_agg_taluk_month.closing_balance.doc: Scheme balance at the end of the month (all schemes). A position: never add across months.

mart_agg_taluk_month.total_number_of_sta.doc: Staff on the payroll in the month (all staff types). A snapshot: never add across months.

mart_agg_taluk_month.number_of_staff_sal.doc: Staff paid in the month (all staff types).
Salaries the bank rejected in the month (all staff types).
